title: CHAPTER_META v1.0
description: Structured per-chapter review intermediate. Emitted by every Pass 1 (local) agent in /story-review alongside its natural-language FINDINGS. Aggregated by scripts/aggregate-review.sh in Pass 2 for cumulative-pattern detection. The whole-prose load is never reconstituted from CHAPTER_META — this schema is the cumulative-review contract.

schema_version.description: Pinned to '1.0' for this release. Future bumps require story-review version bump.

chapter_id.description: Stable identifier for the chapter. Recommended: file path relative to project root (e.g., '《书名》/正文/第241章_审判庭.md') or canonical chapter number ('第241章'). Must match across all agents reviewing the same chapter.

verdict.description: This agent's verdict on the chapter (mirrors the agent's natural-language VERDICT).

ai_grade.description: Subjective AI-tone severity for THIS chapter. Only narrative-writer is expected to fill meaningfully; other agents may pass-through 'light' if outside their scope.

banned_words_found.description: Banned-words-table matches found in the chapter, with per-word counts.

body_parts_used.description: Body-part word frequency in this chapter (for cross-chapter saturation detection). Same word from quality-checklist 'same body word > 5 times' rule.

rhythm_tags.description: Coarse pacing tags for this chapter (multi-tag allowed when chapter has distinct sections).

sentence_pattern_diversity.description: Detection of 'all paragraphs follow same SVO loop' AI tells. Low = uniform, high = varied.

emotional_beats.description: Ordered emotional checkpoints across the chapter. Used by Pass 2 aggregator to render the volume-level emotional arc.

position_pct.description: Where in the chapter (0=opening, 100=closing) this beat lands.

s1_count.description: Hard contradictions (S1) flagged by consistency-checker in this chapter — usually 0 in Pass 1 since consistency-checker is not spawned per-chapter.

s2_count.description: Major issues (S2) flagged in this chapter.

pov_character.description: Point-of-view character name. Used by Pass 2 to detect POV drift.

char_drift_flag.description: True iff character-designer detected a candidate language-style drift in this chapter (only meaningful at Pass 2 aggregation time).

foreshadow_planted.description: 伏笔 IDs planted in this chapter (matching 追踪/伏笔.md编号 column, e.g., 'F012').

foreshadow_resolved.description: 伏笔 IDs resolved (called back) in this chapter.
